decisions.decision: comuki-cli is no longer an agents/ package
decisions.rationale: Moved to cli/ (a2bddc27, 2026-09-17) and has grown into the most actively developed corner of the TS surface (124+ commits) - keeping it documented under agents/README.md was actively misleading.

decisions.decision: Rescued redis-cache and generic-command-verifier onto pushed branches instead of discarding or silently cherry-picking them
decisions.rationale: Both were complete, real, working-looking implementations sitting only as loose objects in one local clone, within git's gc grace window - pushing rescue/redis-cache and rescue/generic-command-verifier to gitlab gets them off the local-only gc clock. Whether/how to restore onto master is still an open call - not decided here.

next_action: No single next action - four independent tracks are open: (1) finish harden-pi-worker-sandbox's remaining 12/27 tasks, most urgently the worker-sdk pi-extensions lock-gate integration since locks do not run inside the pi worker at all today; (2) finish enrich-chat-parts (2 tasks left, cheapest win); (3) decompose add-mission-cowork into its first child change, execution-spine-orchestration (#87), which gates everything else in the epic; (4) decide whether to restore rescue/redis-cache and rescue/generic-command-verifier (both recoverable now, but exposed to gc if left indefinitely) or supersede them with v2 designs.
